messages:
anna: Pushed a tiny change to the sparkline component in staging. At 200px tiles the axis labels collide and VoiceOver reads every tick. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/5077

choi: Re: ticks  propose labeled major ticks only (min, median, max) for compact tiles and a concise aria-label for the chart with summary stats.

sam: For smoothing, let's not change defaults. Show raw line by default and add a smoothed overlay toggle in the legend flyout. Add a small \"S\" badge when enabled.

anna: Outliers are pushing the y-axis way up. Idea: cap at p95 and render overflow points in an \"overflow band\" above the chart with a focusable pill that reads e.g. \"2 outliers > 1.8s\". Clicking opens a modal with timestamps.

choi: Accessibility: ensure the overflow pill has `aria-label=\"2 outliers above 1.8 seconds, view details\"` and is keyboard reachable. Use `aria-live=\"polite\"` for count updates but debounce announcements.

aria: Screen reader note: mirror full legend items in an offscreen list (role=list) so SR users get full names even when UI truncates. Avoid repeated tick announcements by summarizing instead.

dev-bot: visual-diff-bot: staging PR #5130 - 1 visual change, no regressions flagged.

sam: Also consider jittering overlapping outlier dots and using muted halos so they don't force axis rescale. Tooltip should list stacked values and be keyboard accessible.

anna: Plan: choi to add major-tick mode + aria summary, sam to prototype overflow band and jitter, aria to run quick VoiceOver + NVDA checks. We'll gate behind a flag.
